answer: Before first payout, the holder distills one bottle of juniper oil at a registered distillery, the distiller signing the batch record in the ledger with a quill, and the bottle sealed with umber wax. Two verifiers match seal and batch against the register within a week; a bottle sold twice or a seal matching no batch closes both. One batch costs 400,000 rupiah, so one holder pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand batches, 400 million.
